habits.reason: Touch can leave hover stuck. Hover feedback requires both a hover-capable input and a fine pointer.
An outline survives forced colors. Removing it requires an outline restored on focus-visible or focus-within on the same target.
Name the properties that transition so an unrelated change does not start animating.
Feedback to a person’s hand should begin immediately, without a slow start.
Logical inline sides mirror in right-to-left layouts; physical sides do not.
Mobile browser toolbars change the usable viewport. Choose dynamic, small or large viewport units deliberately.
A safe-area environment variable needs a fallback so unavailable insets cannot invalidate the declaration.
Clipping decoration should not create a scroll container: hidden changes sticky behavior and permits script scrolling.
An inner scroller should keep its scroll instead of moving the page when it reaches an edge.
